question: In Urothelial trials comparing ICI to placebo, infer from the trial name whether ICI was used as induction or maintenance.
pred_sql: SELECT "NCT", "Trial name", "Cancer type", "Name of ICI", "Control regimen", "Type of control", "Clincal setting in relation to surgery" FROM clinical_trials WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Urothelial' AND "Control regimen" = 'Placebo' AND "Type of control" = 'Placebo'
